description: Removes one entry from the trusted senders the business accepts email from, as the allow list's Remove does (an admin control). sender_id comes from the list you read. This filters inbound email; nothing is sent. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: delete_allowed_sender
title: Stop trusting a sender for email sync
